job_no.description: the external BC job number, kept as the reconciliation key back to the ERP

job_status.description: BC's own job status text, passed through verbatim

percent_completed.description: WIP / cost-recognition completion for the job, clamped to `[0, 105]`, null when the BC WIP calc is invalid

percent_invoiced.description: the share of the job claimed/invoiced to date, clamped `[0, 105]`

percent_overdue_planning_lines.description: planning-line slippage signal on the job

project_id.description: the project (BC job) the KPIs belong to; the fact's subject anchor

source_system.description: which bound ERP the KPIs were read from

suspect.description: the raw rejected value(s) and the reason, present only when a percentage fell outside `[0, 105]`
